title: Red Hat Security Advisory: OpenShift Container Platform 4.21.42 bug fix and security update
description: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.21.42 includes critical security updates addressing two vulnerabilities: a kernel IPv4 memory handling issue (CVE-2026-98432) and an out-of-bounds write in the Google Brotli decoder (CVE-2026-111497). These fixes are delivered via updated container images and RPM packages. Users of OpenShift Container Platform 4.21 are advised to upgrade to these updated versions to mitigate the vulnerabilities.
